sections.section_name: Section A - Objective Types / MCQs / True-False

questions.question_text: In a basketball game, moving both feet without bouncing the ball is a violation known as:
questions.answer: B) Traveling

questions.question_text: Which Yoga practice primarily focuses on controlled, deep, and rhythmic breathing?
questions.answer: B) Pranayama

questions.question_text: True or False: Team games only develop physical strength and have no impact on social skills.
questions.answer: B) False

questions.question_text: Which of the following is considered a core defensive skill in Volleyball?
questions.answer: C) Blocking

questions.question_text: Which asana is known as the 'Sun Salutation' and involves a sequence of 12 distinct postures?
questions.answer: A) Surya Namaskar

questions.question_text: In a hockey match, players (except the goalkeeper) are strictly forbidden from touching the ball with their:
questions.answer: B) Feet

questions.question_text: What does 'Holistic Health' in Physical Education refer to?
options: B) Complete physical, mental, and social well-being
C) Being free from all injuries forever
questions.answer: B) Complete physical, mental, and social well-being

questions.question_text: The primary goal of practicing 'Shavasana' (Corpse Pose) at the end of a Yoga session is to:
options: C) Achieve deep physical and mental relaxation
questions.answer: C) Achieve deep physical and mental relaxation

questions.question_text: Which term describes treating opponents with respect, playing fair, and accepting defeat gracefully?
questions.answer: B) Sportsmanship

questions.question_text: In Football (Soccer), a 'throw-in' is awarded when the ball fully crosses which line?
questions.answer: C) The touchline (sideline)

questions.question_text: What is the primary objective of a 'pass' in team games like Football or Basketball? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The primary objective is to move the ball swiftly to a teammate in a better position, bypassing defenders to create a scoring opportunity.

questions.question_text: State two key physical benefits of regularly practicing Vrikshasana (Tree Pose). [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Regular practice of Vrikshasana significantly improves overall body balance and strengthens the leg muscles, particularly the ankles and calves.

questions.question_text: Define 'Offside' in the context of Football (Soccer). [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A player is offside if they are nearer to the opponent's goal line than both the ball and the second-last opponent when the ball is played to them.

questions.question_text: How does deep breathing in Yoga (Pranayama) affect a player's mental state before a match? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Deep breathing calms the nervous system, drastically reducing pre-match anxiety and stress, while simultaneously improving the player's mental focus and concentration.

questions.question_text: Mention one important rule regarding the goalkeeper's privileges in Football. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The goalkeeper is the only player permitted to deliberately handle the ball with their hands or arms, but only within their own penalty area.

questions.question_text: Describe the correct technique and posture for a chest pass in Basketball. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Hold the ball with both hands at chest level, elbows tucked in. Step forward with one foot, extend your arms forcefully, and snap your wrists outward to push the ball in a straight, flat line toward your teammate.

questions.question_text: Explain how participating in team games naturally develops good social skills and cooperation among students. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Team games require students to communicate effectively, trust their peers, and sacrifice personal glory for group success. This continuous interaction builds mutual respect, empathy, and strong collaborative skills essential for daily life.

questions.question_text: Outline the proper physical alignment required when performing Padmasana (Lotus Pose). [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Sit on the floor with a straight spine. Place the right foot onto the left thigh, and the left foot onto the right thigh. Rest your hands on your knees in a mudra, keeping your head and neck aligned.

questions.question_text: In a game of Volleyball, explain the tactical purpose of a 'setter' in organizing the team's offense. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The setter acts as the team's playmaker. Their tactical purpose is to receive the first pass and accurately lift or 'set' the ball near the net, creating a perfect opportunity for the attacker to spike it forcefully.

questions.question_text: A school team frequently loses matches because players argue and try to score individually instead of passing. Based on the fundamental skills of team games and sportsmanship, write a tactical plan to improve their performance and unity. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The coach must implement a strict passing drill, rewarding assists over individual goals to build trust. Tactical team meetings should focus on specific positional roles, ensuring players understand they are part of a unit. Emphasizing sportsmanship will reduce arguing, teaching them to support each other during mistakes, ultimately creating a cohesive, winning team dynamic.

questions.question_text: A student feels highly stressed before final exams and often experiences back pain from sitting too long. Recommend a brief daily Yoga routine consisting of specific Asanas and Pranayama to restore their physical and mental balance. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The student should start with Anulom Vilom (alternate nostril breathing) for five minutes to immediately reduce exam stress and clear the mind. To relieve back pain, they must perform Bhujangasana (Cobra Pose) to stretch the spine, followed by Tadasana (Mountain Pose) to correct sitting posture. Ending with Shavasana will ensure complete relaxation and mental clarity.
